name: KinesisStreamsOutputDescription
description: For an SQL-based Kinesis Data Analytics application's output, describes the Kinesis data stream that is configured as its destination.

allOf.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Kinesis data stream.

The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Analytics can assume to access the stream.

Provided for backward compatibility. Applications that are created with the current API version have an application-level service execution role rather than a resource-level role.
